## Today

> - Discussion driven by your reading reviews
> - We'll close the loop on the semester by asking: do the theories hold up?

## What Has Technology Changed?

> - Remote and hybrid work — what happens to socialization, culture, informal communication?
> - Social media — how does it change the boundary between inside and outside an organization?
> - AI and automation — which jobs change, which disappear, and what does that do to the worker's role?
> - Surveillance technology — Theory X with better tools?

## What Hasn't Changed?

> - People still need to belong, to be recognized, to have voice
> - Power still operates through communication
> - Organizations still have cultures, norms, and conflicts
> - Which of the theories we've studied do you think is *most* robust to technological change?

## The Gig Economy and Organizing Without Organizations

> - What happens to classical, HR, and systems theory when workers don't have a single employer?
> - What does "organizational communication" even mean for someone who is their own employer?
> - Are platforms like Uber, Fiverr, or TaskRabbit organizations — and if so, what kind?

## Looking Back

> - What concept from this course surprised you the most?
> - What will you actually remember in five years?
> - What will you look for differently when you join an organization after graduation?
